Cors._comment: Browser origins allowed to call this API (security fix F-07). Intentionally empty here — no cross-origin access by default. Add dev origins in appsettings.Development.json and production origins via env vars (Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 etc.).

ConnectionStrings._comment: DefaultConnection is intentionally empty here. Supply it via .NET user-secrets for local dev (dotnet user-secrets set 'ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection' ...) or the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable in prod. See appsettings.example.json.

Jwt._comment: DEV PLACEHOLDER KEY ONLY. In production override Jwt:Key via env var / secret store (e.g. Jwt__Key). Must be >= 32 bytes for HS256.

MlService._comment: AdminApiKey is intentionally empty here. It authenticates the /admin/ingest-news call to the ML service (X-API-Key header, security fix F-02) and must equal the ML service's ML_ADMIN_API_KEY env var. Supply it via .NET user-secrets for local dev (dotnet user-secrets set 'MlService:AdminApiKey' ...) or the MlService__AdminApiKey environment variable in prod.
